primary.name: Artificial Analysis
primary.attribution: Benchmark data: Artificial Analysis (artificialanalysis.ai). Refresh with `npm run vendor:model-data` (needs ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY).

anchor.note: Speed anchor. Official claims: >1,100 tok/s (NVIDIA NIM model card, H100 FP8 low batch), 1,000+ tok/s on H100 / 700+ on RTX 5090 (Google), ~1,500 tok/s (technical report). Provider-side end-to-end Output Speed from Artificial Analysis was not published at capture time, so the scout runs relative-speed scoring and records estimated:true until the snapshot carries a measured number.

notes: Starter snapshot: no invented measurements. Run `npm run vendor:model-data` with ARTIFICIAL_ANALYSIS_API_KEY to fill `models`.
Until then the scout scores capability heuristics (fast/reasoning/context/vision) and marks every pick estimated:true with source 'heuristic'.
The curated NIM recommended list remains the last-resort fallback when the live catalogue itself is unavailable.
